# Yuka components

Vendored unmodified from https://github.com/Mugen87/yuka at commit `10591304811222d6856020d5de129b39ef43b58d`. MIT; see LICENSE.

- `src/goal/GoalEvaluator.js` → `GoalEvaluator.mjs`: deterministic goal desirability interfaces used by actor-decisions.
- `src/graph/extra/PriorityQueue.js` → `PriorityQueue.mjs`: binary heap used by resumable path jobs; original tinyqueue attribution retained.

No runtime package download or LLM call. Region reachability and fixed work budgets follow public game AI patterns; no proprietary RimWorld, Clanfolk or ONI code is imported.
